UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Owner-private user account profile storing chosen display name, unique handle, 4-digit PIN, and online presence.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in chats (2-40 characters).

HandleDirectoryEntry.title: HandleDirectoryEntry
HandleDirectoryEntry.description: Public, PII-free handle lookup document keyed by lowercase handle so authenticated users can discover peers by exact handle and observe presence.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this handle.

handle.description: Lowercase unique handle matching the document ID.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of last seen presence (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: 1-on-1 direct conversation or multi-member group chat with real-time last message preview and read receipt state.

chatType.description: Whether this conversation is a 1-on-1 direct chat or a group chat.

name.description: Group name or direct chat fallback title (1-60 characters).

creatorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the chat.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (1-50) of member Firebase Auth UIDs.

memberLabels.description: Map from member UID to 'handle|displayName' label.

lastMessageText.description: Plain English preview of the most recent message (0-1000 chars).

lastMessageSenderId.description: UID of the sender of the most recent message.

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent message (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

readByUids.description: Bounded list (0-50) of member UIDs who have read the latest message.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Message stored as plain English text and rendered via custom 26-letter SVG cipher glyphs, with reply references and read receipts.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Display name of the sender (1-40 chars).

memberUids.description: Denormalized bounded list (1-50) of parent chat member UIDs for fast local authorization.

readByUids.description: Bounded list (1-50) of member UIDs who have read this message.

deleted.description: Whether this message has been deleted by its author.

replyToMessageId.description: Optional ID of the message being replied to.

replyToText.description: Optional plain English excerpt of the replied message.

replyToSenderName.description: Optional display name of the replied message author.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-private user account profile keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/handles/{handleId}.description: PII-free unique handle registry supporting single-doc handle lookup and live presence.

/chats/{chatId}.description: 1-on-1 direct chats and group chat rooms scoped strictly to memberUids.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time messages inside a chat room with denormalized memberUids.
